whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Dryclean Care for Jeans?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Denim is durable, but home washing machines and harsh agitators fade indigo dyes, twist outseams and degrade stretch fibres over time. Here is why professional dryclean care makes the difference:

points.title: Colour & Indigo Retention
points.desc: Home detergents and harsh agitation wash out rich indigo dye. Our low-friction process preserves color depth and prevents uneven streakiness.

points.title: Shape & Seam Integrity
points.desc: Spin cycles twist denim leg seams and stretch out waistbands. Professional finishing resets the original leg contour and silhouette.

points.title: Stretch & Elastane Protection
points.desc: Modern stretch denim contains elastane that degrades under high dryer heat. We use calibrated temperatures to protect stretch recovery.

points.title: Hardware & Stitching Longevity
points.desc: Rivets, brass zippers, and heavy chain-stitching stay intact without snagging or rusting during our dryclean cycle.

points.title: Surface Finish & Soft Texture
points.desc: Say goodbye to the stiff, cardboard-like feeling of air-dried denim. High-pressure steam softens the weave while crisping edges.

points.title: Wrinkle Management
points.desc: Stubborn crinkles behind knees and around the waistband are pressed smooth without flattening the garment's natural 3D shape.

stainTreatment.title: Tough Stains? We Treat Them Before the Dryclean.
stainTreatment.subtitle: Jeans face some of the most stubborn everyday marks. Stains are assessed and pre-treated before your denim goes into the dryclean machine.

detailCare.title: Every Detail Matters
detailCare.subtitle: Denim is built differently from ordinary clothing. Here is how the Wash4You dryclean studio treats every element:

details.title: Fabric Composition
details.desc: Appropriate treatment based on fabric composition, whether 100% rigid cotton, elastane stretch blend, or heavy raw selvedge.

details.title: Colour Preservation
details.desc: Careful handling to help maintain the garment's appearance, guarding dark indigos and saturated blacks against premature fading.

details.title: Stitching & Seams
details.desc: Attention to heavy outseams, inseams, and chain-stitched hems so lines are pressed flat without twisting or pulling.

details.title: Buttons & Fasteners
details.desc: Inspection during processing. Metal button shanks, copper rivets, and brass zip teeth are handled to prevent snagging or damage.

details.title: Pockets & Linings
details.desc: Inspection for foreign objects before processing. Pocket linings are smoothed flat so they never bunch uncomfortably.

details.title: Shape & Silhouette
details.desc: Finishing intended to maintain the garment's natural form, resetting the waist, hip contour, and leg line accurately.

faqs.q: How much does jeans dry cleaning cost at Wash4You?
faqs.a: Jeans Dryclean & Press starts from ₹109 per piece, while Steam Pressing starts from ₹69 per piece. All prices are transparent and exclusive of 18% GST. There are no additional pickup or delivery charges.

faqs.q: How long does jeans dry cleaning take?
faqs.a: Steam Press and Dryclean & Press turnaround is confirmed when we collect your order. Same-day or next-day express options are available depending on pickup timing and route availability.

faqs.q: Should I choose dryclean or steam pressing?
faqs.a: Choose Steam Press when your jeans are already clean but have creases, wrinkles, or stiffness and need a sharp finish. Choose Dryclean & Press when the jeans have been worn, have visible stains, mud, or body oils, or require a thorough hygienic wash.

faqs.q: Can you remove stains from jeans?
faqs.a: Visible stains are identified and pre-treated before the main cleaning process. However, treatment results depend on the type of stain, fabric condition, age of the stain, and previous home washing. While we use specialized spotting agents, complete removal cannot be guaranteed for every mark.

faqs.q: Can you clean expensive or premium jeans?
faqs.a: Yes. Garments are assessed individually according to their fabric composition, raw dye intensity, and care label instructions. We take special care with selvedge, Japanese denim, coated fabrics, and designer embellishments.

faqs.q: What if my jeans have buttons, zippers or embellishments?
faqs.a: All fastenings, metal rivets, zip flies, and embellishments are checked during item inspection and handled carefully throughout the cleaning and pressing process to prevent scratching or damage.
